title: Interpretability
purpose: A proposed course in the Corniversity catalogue (Optional advanced elective). Methods for understanding learned representations and mechanisms, and what each method actually supports; an attractive visualisation or a plausible verbal story is not a mechanistic explanation.
description: Proposed course: Interpretability. Central question: What do interpretability methods actually establish about a learned model? Source verification and syllabus design have not been completed, so no teaching material exists yet. You may register interest or ask the director about it; nothing is prepared on request.

centralQuestion: What do interpretability methods actually establish about a learned model?
prerequisiteGuidance: CSA-210 Deep Learning Foundations (at least its representation units) and enough programming to train a small model.
preparationPath: Resolve primary sources for two contrasting method families (for example probing and causal intervention) with stated limitations; prepare a first unit on a modest model.
plannedActivities: Apply or analyse two interpretability methods on a modest model and compare their conclusions, limitations and robustness.
